In [[geometry]], the '''great icosahedral 120-cell''', '''great polyicosahedron''' or '''great [[faceting|faceted]] 600-cell''' is a [[regular star 4-polytope]] with [[Schläfli symbol]] {3,5/2,5}. It is one of 10 regular [[Schläfli-Hess polytope]]s.

== Related polytopes ==

It has the same [[edge arrangement]] as the [[great stellated 120-cell]], and [[grand stellated 120-cell]], and [[face arrangement]] of the [[grand 600-cell]].
